column1: # Spoken (street) Indonesian forms and their formal twins: street<TAB>formal.
# One shared list (crates/core lang::street): reading coverage counts a street
# form as known once its formal twin is taught, and answer grading folds a
# street answer onto the formal one. Chat abbreviations (yg, gk, udh…) live in
# the normalizer instead. Particles with no formal twin (sih, dong, deh, kok,
# lho) are taught or glossed on their own and are not listed.
